newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - BankBoston Q2 oper income increases.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - BankBoston Q2 oper income increases.

text.p: (All data above in millions, avg shrs in ,000s)
NOTE: Net income for the second quarter of 1997 includes a gain of approximately $20 million from the sale of Argentine securities and a restructuring charge of $3 million for its Asian operations.
The company said that during the second quarter of 1997 it continued its buyback program, repurchasing five million shares.
Net income for the second quarter of 1996 included a gain of $46 million from the sale of a mortgage subsidiary.
Net income for the first six months of 1996 included a gain of $106 million from the sale of a mortgage facility and a loss of $111 from contracts used to manage the prepayment of risk.

In addition, the bank paid preferred dividends of $9.3 million in the second quarters of 1997 and 1996. The bank also paid preferred dividends of $18.6 million in the first six months of 1997 and 1996.
Net income was calculated before the payment of preferred dividends; earnings per share were calculated after the payment of preferred dividends.
